abstract: The circulating levels of chorionic gonadotropin, pregnancy specific beta-I-glycoprotein, prolactin and oestradiol were estimated by radioimmunoassay in 219 serum samples from 18 patients with choriocarcinoma and 45 samples from 8 patients with hydatidiform mole. Prolactin and oestradiol concentrations were higher in samples which also contained trophoblastic markers. This difference was also seen in patients with choriocarcinoma and it was not due to chemotherapy, since the difference between hCG positive and hCG negative samples was maintained during chemotherapy. Prolactin was found by immunoperoxidase technique in the syncytiotrophoblast of normal placenta throughout gestation, and also in hydatidiform mole, invasive mole and choriocarcinoma. It is suggested that the malignant syncytiotrophoblast may contribute to circulating prolactin levels either by direct secretion of prolactin or by oestrogen stimulation of the pituitary.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌18例の血清219検体および胞状奇胎8例の血清45検体について、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン、妊娠特異的β1糖タンパク、プロラクチン、エストラジオールの血中濃度をラジオイムノアッセイで測定した。栄養膜マーカーを含む検体ではプロラクチンおよびエストラジオールが高値であった。この差は絨毛癌の患者でも認められ、化学療法によるものではなかった。化学療法中もhCG陽性検体と陰性検体の差は維持された。プロラクチンは免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法により、妊娠全期間の正常胎盤の合胞体栄養膜細胞に加え、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌にも認められた。悪性の合胞体栄養膜細胞が、直接的なプロラクチン分泌、あるいはエストロゲンによる下垂体刺激を介して、血中プロラクチン値に寄与している可能性が示唆される。
